scheme_name: Revised Education Scheme For Children Of Artisans/Weavers Of Handicrafts And Handloom Departments
other_conditions: Parent must be a registered Weaver/Artisan with a valid registration certificate from the Handicrafts and Handloom Departments
Applicant must not have received benefits under Pre‑Matric Scholarship Scheme, Post‑Matric Scholarship Scheme, Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or any other scheme
Applicant must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Zonal Educational Officer and the Tehsil Social Welfare Officer
Applicant must possess either a BPL Card, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Ration Card, Priority Household (PHH) Card, or an Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Certificate
Parents' total annual income must be ≤ ₹90,000 and an Income Certificate issued by the 1st Class Magistrate/Tehsildar is required
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹1500 per year up to primary education, ₹2000 per year for classes 6‑10, ₹3000 per year for classes 11‑12, and tuition‑fee coverage for technical/professional courses, paid via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
documents_required: Registration certificate from Handicrafts and Handloom Departments
Income Certificate issued by 1st Class Magistrate/Tehsildar
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Zonal Educational Officer
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Tehsil Social Welfare Officer
